notes.title: Flesh Made Fear Demo – Now Haunting Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
The time has come, sinners.
Steam Next Fest has begun, and with it, Flesh Made Fear is clawing its way onto your screens with a challenging demo that takes you back to your childhood gaming era—playing horror games in the dark of your children's room. If you thought you were ready… think again.

This retro-inspired PSX horror experience is here to test your nerves, your instincts—and maybe your soul. Get ready for gritty visuals, relentless tension, and a nightmare that doesn’t play fair.


By the way ...  the fear becomes real this Halloween already![previewyoutube="AxDBVgIlp44;full"][/previewyoutube]

💀 What’s waiting for you in the demo?
A slice of terror from the full game, with brutal encounters, grim environments, and no mercy. Whether you’re a seasoned survivor or fresh meat, we dare you to try.


The demo will kick your retro PSX butts—and you’ll thank it when it’s over.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489218/f31e2ed461a07aa7ec9553141e77759e9e06ae9f.png"]

We're beyond thrilled to share this glimpse into the horror we’ve been crafting, and we’d love to hear your thoughts. If you enjoyed the demo (or barely made it through), leaving a short review would help us out tremendously.

Thanks for playing—and good luck out there. You’ll need it.

— Michael

notes.title: Demo Update *Added D-Pad Functionality*
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489218/0c99eea3dcd1a21a573b3e2357695df364a07796.jpg

D-pad controls are now fully implemented for character movement in the demo.
Also, fixed a couple of typos on the game and also had Daniel Suraci re-record some of his voice lines. I have now updated his audio files with his new takes!

Thank you for the fantastic response and feedback to the demo so far! I look forward to sharing more with you all as development continues for the full release.
